modern: Do not labour as one who is wretched, nor as one who would be pitied or admired; but direct your will to one thing only—to set yourself in motion and to check yourself, as the social reason requires.
original: Labor not as one who is wretched, nor yet as one who would be pitied or admired; but direct thy will to one thing only—to put thyself in motion and to check thyself, as the social reason requires.
